answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored to a unique, costly-to-forge digital identity, akin to a crystal certification. Each agent is assigned a distinct onyx token, which is staked to participate in consensus. An attacker attempting a Sybil attack must expend resources to acquire and maintain multiple tokens, navigating a vast, data-rich meadow of verification checks. The cost of creating and sustaining fake identities far exceeds potential gains, deterring attackers and securing the network.
